acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in “top-15” data-dependent mode, collecting MS spectra in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
alkylation reagent: peptides with a minimum length of seven amino acids with carbamidomethylation as a fixed modification
cleavage agent: 300 µg were further processed for overnight digestion by adding Lys-C and trypsin in a 1:50 ratio
collision energy: Following higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 27%
fractionation method: About 30 µg of peptides of each sample were further fractionated into 54 fractions and concatenated into 8 fractions by high-pH reversed-phase fractionation
fragmentation method: Following higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 27%
instrument: Nanoflow LC–MS/MS analysis of tryptic peptides was conducted on a quadrupole Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive HF, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL, USA)
ionization type: coupled to an EASYnLC 1200 ultra-high-pressure system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) via a nano-electrospray ion source
labeling: The resulting 400 samples were analyzed with a state-of-the-art label-free workflow on a quadrupole– Orbitrap mass spectrometer
